subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

It is time to take tea.

options.text: It is time for the tea to be taken
It is time tea must have been taken.
It is time we should take the tea.
It is time the tea has to be taken by us.

solution:
The correct answer is **"It is time for the tea to be taken."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in active voice with the subject** "it" **and the verb **"to take."**
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the **object (tea)** the subject and use the passive form of the verb** "to take" (be taken)**.
 
• **Structure:**
 
• **It is time to + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)**
 
• It is time for + Object + to be V3. (Passive Voice)
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *It is time to play cricket. (Active Voice)*
 
• *It is time for cricket to be played. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence:* ****It is time for the tea to be taken**.*
